BiblicalUsage: This is the noun form of growth — the increase itself. Paul uses it of the body growing with the increase of God as it holds fast to the Head, and of the whole body growing as every part does its work.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a healthy church grows the way a body grows: joined to Christ, each part supplying what the others need.
